chatport: unrecognized export archive: no conversations.json entry (supported: ChatGPT data export; cn export adapter ships in v0.3 after the Gate-0 audit (see README roadmap))

verification.golden_test: internal/ingest/chatgpt_test.go covers branch linearization (current_node), hidden system nodes, code parts, tool roles, cross-conversation dedup counting

limitations: v0.1 only parses ChatGPT data exports (conversations.json); no CN app adapter is wired yet (Gate-0 audit precedes v0.3).
Rendering (claude-projects-pack.zip) is not implemented in this milestone; --json exposes the Context Pack IR that v0.2 will render.
Dedup is deterministic exact-match after whitespace normalization (sha256 fingerprint); no semantic dedup.
Project hints come from title prefixes only (【…】, […], Project:, 项目：/项目:).
Memory items, custom instructions and files are not part of ChatGPT exports and therefore not part of the Pack.
The interactive web preview is a placeholder in v0.1; `chatport open` serves version info and usage guidance only.
